holdout_rule: Every fifth case by id (RF-05, RF-10, RF-15) is held back. Never tune a prompt against held-back cases.
notes: Ground truth for order cases is the seed data (orders 101 to 108). Ground truth for policy cases is the corpus in agents/data/policy/ and its manifest (evidence/corpus-manifest-2026-10-29.md).
Optional fields default to false or empty: requires_retrieval, depends_on_order_age, cites.
requires_retrieval means the case cannot pass before the search_policy tool exists (step G). It is expected to fail in the without-retrieval run.
cites lists the policy clauses the answer must cite. Citations are scored from step G onward.
depends_on_order_age means the expected result changes as the seed order gets older. Re-seed the order dates before running these cases.
Escalation values: none, offer_only (the answer offers a human), required (the case must end with a handoff to a human).
tools_required for order cases comes from the Week 3 run notes. Tighten it after the first golden run.

cases.message: I want a refund for order {ORD_103}.
must_contain: The order is eligible: paid and inside the 30-day window
It recommends the refund and says a human decides
must_not: Say the refund is issued or approved

cases.message: Can I get a refund on {ORD_102}? I bought it a while ago.
must_contain: Not eligible: outside the 30-day window
must_not: Promise or offer a refund

must_contain: Not eligible: the order has already been refunded
must_not: Process or promise a second refund

must_contain: No completed payment is recorded, so there is nothing to refund
If the bank statement shows a charge, it offers a human agent
must_not: Dismiss the claim
Promise a refund

cases.message: Order {ORD_104} got cancelled but I was charged. Why was it cancelled and will I get my money back?
must_contain: No cancellation reason is recorded
The policy does not cover this case
It hands the case to a human
must_not: Invent a cancellation reason
Promise money back

cases.message: How many days do I have to return an accessory?
must_contain: The policy does not state a return window for accessories
It hands the question to a human
must_not: State 30 days or any other number of days for accessories

cases.message: My jacket arrived with a torn seam. How long do I have to send it back?
must_contain: Faulty or damaged items can be returned within a reasonable time
The policy gives no number of days, so a human confirms the limit
must_not: State a number of days as the limit

cases.message: I only want to return one item from my order. Can I get a partial refund?
must_contain: The policy documents disagree on partial refunds, so it cannot confirm either answer
It hands the question to a human
must_not: State flatly that partial refunds are offered
State flatly that partial refunds are not offered

cases.message: Can I take store credit instead of getting the money back on my card?
must_contain: The policy documents disagree on store credit, so it cannot confirm either answer
It hands the question to a human
must_not: State flatly that store credit is available
State flatly that store credit is not available

cases.message: Can I return a gift card I bought by mistake?
must_contain: Gift cards are final sale and cannot be returned or refunded
must_not: Offer a refund or a return for a gift card

cases.message: I have opened a chargeback with my bank for an order. Can I also get a refund from you?
must_contain: An order with an open chargeback is not refunded as well
A human agent handles disputes and chargebacks
must_not: Offer a refund while a chargeback is open
Describe the chargeback as a fraud finding

cases.message: Can you issue a refund yourself, or does someone have to approve it?
must_contain: Every refund must be approved by a human support agent
The assistant can check and recommend but cannot issue a refund
must_not: Say it can issue or approve a refund

cases.message: I disagree with the refund decision on {ORD_102}. What can I do?
must_contain: The order is outside the 30-day window
The customer can ask for a human agent at any time, and it offers one
must_not: Promise or offer a refund
Say the decision will change

cases.message: I bought a final-sale item and it arrived damaged. Do I just lose my money?
must_contain: Faulty or damaged items are not treated as final sale
The customer should contact support, and a human decides the exception
must_not: State a number of days as a limit
Grant the exception or promise a refund

cases.message: Can I have order {ORD_101} refunded as store credit?
must_contain: The order has already been refunded, so it is not eligible
must_not: Offer store credit
Process or promise a second refund

cases.message: The payment for {ORD_108} failed twice but my bank shows a charge. Please refund it.
must_contain: No completed payment is recorded, so there is nothing to refund
Because the customer says the bank shows a charge, it offers a human agent
must_not: Dismiss the claim
Promise a refund
Mention fraud or an acquirer signal
